name: IdentificationOrProxyPresenceRule
text: Identification must be present or proxy must be present.

name: IdentificationAndProxyGuideline
text: If the account identification is not defined through a conventional identification such as an email address or a mobile number, then the proxy element should be used for the identification of the account.

name: ForwardBalanceAndAvailabilityRule
text: If Type is equal to ForwardAvailable, Availability is not allowed.

name: ReferenceGuideline
text: At least one reference should be present to identify the underlying transaction(s).

name: ExchangeRateBaseGuideline
text: Exchange Rate Base may only be present if bilaterally agreed.

name: DomainOrProprietaryRule
text: Either Proprietary or Domain or both must be present.

name: FamilyAndSubFamilyRule
text: If a specific (non-generic) Family code is not present, then a specific (non-generic) SubFamily code is not allowed.

name: PaymentTypeOrLocalInstrumentRule
text: PaymentTypeInformation or LocalInstrument must be absent, both can be absent.

name: DescriptionPresenceRule
text: If Description is not present then either ISIN or at least one occurrence of OtherIdentification must be present.

name: OtherIdentificationPresenceRule
text: If OtherIdentification is not present then either ISIN or Description must be present.

name: ISINPresenceRule
text: If ISIN is not present then either Description or at least one occurrence of OtherIdentification must be present.

name: DescriptionUsageRule
text: Description must be used alone as the last resort.

name: ISINGuideline
text: When an ISIN code exists, it is strongly recommended that the ISIN be used.

name: ReturnReasonRule
text: If Reason/Code is equal to NARR, then AdditionalInformation must be present.

name: EventTypeRule
text: If Code is present, the code OTHR (Other) must only be used if no other corporate action event code is appropriate. If Code is present, the code CHAN (Change) must only be used if no other corporate action event code is appropriate and only for an event which relates to a change. If Code is present, the code REDM (Final Maturity) must only be used if the redemption is decided by the issuer and not by the securities holders.

name: DigitalTokenUnitUsageRule
text: DigitalTokenUnit format may only be used for instruments identified with a digital token identifier.

name: GroupCancellationAndNumberOfTransactionsRule
text: If OriginalGroupInformationAndCancellation/GroupCancellation is false, then NumberOfTransactions must equal the number of occurrences of TransactionInformation.

name: GroupCancellationTrueAndTransactionInformationRule
text: If OriginalGroupInformationAndCancellation/GroupCancellation is true, then TransactionInformation is not allowed.

name: GroupCancellationFalseAndTransactionInformationRule
text: If OriginalGroupInformationAndCancellation/GroupCancellation is false, then TransactionInformation must be present.

name: GroupOrTransactionCaseRule
text: Case may be present at either Case, OriginalGroupInformationAndCancellation, OriginalPaymentInformationAndCancellation or TransactionInformation level.

name: GroupCancellationAndReasonRule
text: If GroupCancellation is true, then CancellationReasonInformation/Reason must present.

name: GroupOrPaymentInformationResolvedCaseRule
text: ResolvedCase may be present at either ResolvedCase, OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus level, OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus or TransactionInformationAndStatus level.

name: GroupOrInitiationTransactionResolvedCaseRule
text: ResolvedCase may be present at either ResolvedCase, OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus level, OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus or TransactionInformationAndStatus level.

name: GroupOrInterbankTransactionResolvedCaseRule
text: ResolvedCase may be present at either ResolvedCase, OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus level, OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus or TransactionInformationAndStatus level.

name: CancellationStatusReasonInformationRule
text: If GroupCancellationStatus is present and is different from RejectedCancellationRequest (RJCR) or PendingCancellationRequest (PDCR), then CancellationStatusReasonInformation/AdditionalInformation is not allowed.

name: NumberOfTransactionsPerCancellationStatusGuideline
text: OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus/NumberOfTransactionsPerStatus should only be present if GroupCancellationStatus equals PACR.

name: CancellationStatusReasonInformationRule
text: If PaymentInformationCancellationStatus is present and is different from RJCR (RejectedCancellationRequest) or PNCR (PendingCancellationRequest), then CancellationStatusReasonInformation/AdditionalInformation is not allowed.

name: NumberOfTransactionsPerCancellationStatusGuideline
text: OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus/NumberOfTransactionsPerStatus should only be present if GroupCancellationStatus equals PACR (PartialCancellationRequest).

name: PaymentInformationOrTransactionResolvedCaseRule
text: ResolvedCase may be present at either ResolvedCase, OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus level, OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus or TransactionInformationAndStatus level.

name: GroupCancellationAndNumberOfTransactionsRule
text: If OriginalGroupInformationAndCancellation/GroupCancellation is false, then NumberOfTransactions must equal the number of occurrences of TransactionInformation.

name: GroupCancellationTrueAndPaymentInformationRule
text: If OriginalGroupInformationAndCancellation/GroupCancellation is true, then OriginalPaymentInformationAndCancellation is not allowed.

name: GroupCancellationFalseAndPaymentInformationRule
text: If OriginalGroupInformationAndCancellation/GroupCancellation is false, then OriginalPaymentInformationAndCancellation must be present.

name: GroupOrPaymentInformationCaseRule
text: Case may be present at either Case, OriginalGroupInformationAndCancellation, OriginalPaymentInformationAndCancellation or TransactionInformation level.

name: GroupOrTransactionCaseRule
text: Case may be present at either Case, OriginalGroupInformationAndCancellation, OriginalPaymentInformationAndCancellation or TransactionInformation level.

name: PaymentInformationCancellationTrueAndTransactionInformationRule
text: If PaymentInformationCancellation is true, then TransactionInformation is not allowed.

name: PaymentInformationCancellationFalseAndTransactionInformationRule
text: If PaymentInformationCancellation is false, then TransactionInformation must be present.

name: PaymentInformationOrTransactionCaseRule
text: Case may be present at either Case, OriginalGroupInformationAndCancellation, OriginalPaymentInformationAndCancellation or TransactionInformation level.

name: MessageOrStatementPaginationRule
text: MessagePagination may be present or StatementPagination may be present, but not both.

name: SupplementaryDataRule
text: The SupplementaryData building block at message level must not be used to provide additional information about a transaction. The SupplementaryData element at transaction level should be used for that purpose.

name: MessageOrReportPaginationRule
text: MessagePagination may be present or ReportPagination may be present, but not both.

name: SupplementaryDataRule
text: The SupplementaryData building block at message level must not be used to provide additional information about a transaction. The SupplementaryData element at transaction level should be used for that purpose.

name: MessageOrNotificationPaginationRule
text: MessagePagination may be present or NotificationPagination may be present, but not both.

name: SupplementaryDataRule
text: The SupplementaryData building block at message level must not be used to provide additional information about a transaction. The SupplementaryData element at transaction level should be used for that purpose.

name: MessageOrGroupCaseRule
text: Case may be present at either Case, OriginalGroupInformationAndCancellation or TransactionInformation level.

name: MessageOrTransactionCaseRule
text: Case may be present at either Case, OriginalGroupInformationAndCancellation or TransactionInformation level.

name: SupplementaryDataRule
text: The SupplementaryData building block at message level must not be used to provide additional information about a transaction. The SupplementaryData element at transaction level should be used for that purpose.

name: PartialOrRejectedCancellationRule
text: If Status/Confirmation is present and equal to PECR or RJCR then CancellationDetails must be present.

name: MessageOrGroupResolvedCaseRule
text: ResolvedCase may be present at either ResolvedCase, OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus, OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus or TransactionInformationAndStatus level.

name: MessageOrPaymentInformationResolvedCaseRule
text: ResolvedCase may be present at either ResolvedCase, OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus, OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus or TransactionInformationAndStatus level.

name: MessageOrInitiationTransactionResolvedCaseRule
text: ResolvedCase may be present at either ResolvedCase, OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus, OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus or TransactionInformationAndStatus level.

name: MessageOrInterbankTransactionResolvedCaseRule
text: ResolvedCase may be present at either ResolvedCase, OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus, OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus or TransactionInformationAndStatus level.

name: MessageOrGroupCaseRule
text: Case may be present at either Case, OriginalGroupInformationAndCancellation, OriginalPaymentInformationAndCancellation or TransactionInformation level.

name: MessageOrPaymentInformationCaseRule
text: Case may be present at either Case, OriginalGroupInformationAndCancellation, OriginalPaymentInformationAndCancellation or TransactionInformation level.

text: Case may be present at either Case, OriginalGroupInformationAndCancellation, OriginalPaymentInformationAndCancellation or TransactionInformation level.
